ann.t: Stock split — Monarch Networth Capital Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 1 equity shares of Rs. 2 each.

Outcome of Board Meeting — Monarch Networth Capital Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
